params.name: altNamesArray
params.description: Windows: printer network locations/local ports. macOS: custom printer names, editable by the user.

constraints: If printers are managed via a print server/spooler, the returned name is the full access path (Windows) or the spooler name (macOS).
Values returned in namesArray are the ones to pass to SET CURRENT PRINTER and Get current printer to select/read the current printer.
